newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB leaves March prime, debenture rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: LTCB leaves March prime, debenture rates unchanged.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) said on Tuesday it would leave its long-term prime lending rate for March unchanged at 2.5 percent, a record low.
LTCB also said it would leave the coupon rate on its March five-year debentures sold to institutional investors unchanged from the February issue at 1.9 percent.

The long-term prime lending rate, applied to loans of one year and longer to the bank's most creditworthy clients, was last cut in December to a record low at 2.5 percent from 2.7 percent in November.
The unchanged coupon rate for the March issue reflected the yields of LTCB's February 1.9 percent debenture which recently stood at 1.93-1.94 percent, a bank official said.

The spread of the coupon rate of the LTCB five-year debenture against that of the benchmark Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd's will be 30 basis points in March. It widened to 30 points in February from 20 basis points earlier.
